title: Pending with no attempts
keywords: pending waiting queued restart delayed stuck
evidence: PENDING with zero recorded attempts means no risk assessment has been recorded.
action: Cause unconfirmed. Check consumer health and outbox dispatch before considering a replay.

title: Failed risk attempt
keywords: failed retry error unavailable pending stuck
evidence: FAILED with fewer than three attempts is consistent with an automatic retry window in a fresh run.
action: Check retry telemetry and upstream availability. Avoid submitting a second transaction.

title: Repeated risk failures
keywords: failed retry reprocess dead letter exhausted
evidence: Three or more failed attempts warrant inspection. The transaction snapshot alone does not prove a dead-letter event was emitted.
action: Inspect retry history and the dead-letter topic, then involve an operator for controlled replay.

title: Decision already recorded
keywords: duplicate twice completed decided approved declined decision pending
evidence: DECIDED indicates that a risk decision has already been stored.
action: Use the existing decision. Compare references if the customer reports a duplicate.

title: Missing transaction reference
evidence: A reference is required to look up a transaction. A 404 means the service did not find it.
action: Confirm the reference and source feed before taking action.

title: Status unavailable
evidence: The status lookup failed or returned an unsupported snapshot.
action: Check service connectivity or escalate for human review. Avoid inferring a transaction status.
